notes.title: Quality Control Check – Mid July 2024
notes.notes:
Have gone through and fixed SEVERAL areas that were missing zoom points. Also added some zoom spots to the corners which should make navigating and using showrooms easier. 

[b]Phrases[/b] – I split the phrases into two showrooms. The editor was giving me an error when untoggling/toggling the bottom three showrooms so I flipped the cues on by default. Now that I've viewed it on steam though it's okay and will switch it back off during next update. The toggle still functions as it should though! 

[b]Community Section and Screenshots[/b]
I’ve done my first pass through on the screenshots and have made them public in the Community -> Screenshots section. Don’t be shy to downvote if you see a translation or depiction that could be better or should be fixed. I will eventually go in and add captions to them (so you can search for dog or cat and all pictures and translations with those animals will populate in screenshot search). This is so those without gaming computers can search showroom depictions too. Will also make it easier for me to start firing off pictures once I get the facebook pages setup. 

I anticipate I’ll only need to volunteer a couple of more weekends to the Haida language and then I can start switching back and forth from Tlingit and Haida apps (and actually use them myself!). I would love to get all the quirky things worked out though so please use the feedback feature or reach out if you see a major issue that should be fixed in these next couple of weeks.

notes.title: Major Update – English Cues and Showrooms
notes.notes:
**NEW: Effective immediately, all ENGLISH hints will be hidden by default and can be toggled off/on via the HUD. This will allow learners to quiz themselves and not rely solely on the English cues for assistance, but wanted to leave the option in there so they can double check their guess. 

[b]Showrooms Additions (Go easy on me, I grouped as best I could!)[/b]
[list]
[*] Nouns – This showroom contains nouns taken from the Haida Dictionary. In general, you can go clockwise around this room and it will have all nouns in alphabetical order (Haida Alphabet). 
[*] Animal Life – This showroom includes a majority of the mammals listed in the Haida Dictionary. Note that I did run out of space for Birds and Bugs, but those can be accessed directly via the glossary anyhow. 
[*] Community + Education – This floor was a mix of familial relationships, clan relationships, and a mix of general education items. 
[/list]

All in all, this captures over 8,000 of the 10,000 gathered lines of data and am comfortable with the current amount of game pieces on the board that are accessible for the showrooms. I am yearning to make a switch back over to Tlingit, but wanted to make sure I left the Haida app in a good spot before I switch gears. 

Da Ka Xeen
Joshua Clark

notes.title: Showroom Update – Around the World + Being Human
notes.notes:
A little pre-weekend update for the Haida learners. Added two showrooms as another way to explore and play with the language. There is A LOT in just these two showrooms. 

SUPER IMPORTANT NOTE: You can help signpost for future generations and help those that don't have good computers to run the software by simply PRESSING F12 and take as many screenshots as you can. This will get your screenshots to pop up in the Let's Learn Xaad Kil community section. 

Around the World – This floor has a mix of items in the physical world. 
•	Locations
•	Seasons
•	Weather
•	Elements
•	Water related vocabulary
•	Berries
•	Directions

Being Human – This floor has one side filled with body parts in Haida and the other side filled with other elements and/or aspects of being human. 
•	Body Parts
•	Bodily Functions
•	Physical Conditions
•	Physical Actions
•	Mental/Emotional Conditions
•	Nationality/Tribe

My plan is to get the last one or two showrooms done in the next week or so and then the programming work is essentially front-loaded. I am aware some of the words are overlapping! I will fix those when I do a quality control check which is after I get the last few showrooms in. 

Although marketing and social media is the bane of my existence, I plan to adjust how I am doing it (IG only) to using my business email and setup pages for these languages (stay tuned!). I have this vision/dream of just scheduling all the posts for the year on both projects and getting 10 Haida words/pictures a day. 

Da Ka Xeen
Joshua Clark

notes.title: Lexical Glossary Update
notes.notes:
I've added the first draft of lexical entries to the glossary now. This will be ideal for

[list]
[*] Linguists - This provides more dataview options and is a categorized view of all the entries in the H ALPH tab. Allowing you to play with the data views of the word bank. 
[*] Educators / Curriculum Designers - I thought this update might help you out most of all as it will allow you to explore specific subcategories. 
[*] Artists - If I am making a children's book on body parts I can now just go view that section in glossary vs. just using the H ALPH tab. 
[*] Learners - One of the main goals of these programs is to provide multiple ways to pick up the languages and play with them. By exploring these categories it will help familiarize yourself the Haida language and (hopefully) help get you through that rote memorization step. 
[/list]

Some words had more than one meaning (and I can only put it in ONE subcategory), but did my best to keep similar items together. I am working on coding my first c++ function into these programs this weekend, but want to get this change posted and checked off my list in case coding goes awry.

notes.title: Phrases - Showroom Update
notes.notes:
Wanting to share my updated changes to the PHRASES showroom as it's updated from the early access build to a filled out showroom. Taking my time with these next sets of updates to give my hand a rest and not get carpal tunnel, but only real short term goal at this point is to put the lexical categories in the glossary and MAYBE create additional showrooms as needed. As it stands, it functions as a standalone application now and can be released from early access if no audio cues will be added. 

Stay tuned and please don't hesitate to submit any questions or concerns about the software.

Da Ka Xeen
Joshua Clark
